jamie: Heads-up — did a quick pass on the trace viewer drilldown. Couple of accessibility and copy things that stood out. sasha: cool, what did you spot? jamie: 1) stack frame lines that contain long file paths are being truncated with ellipses but aren’t keyboard-focusable to reveal the full path. Suggest either tooltip on focus OR allow line-wrap on narrow widths. oliver: +1 on keyboard focus. tooltips alone don’t help screenreader users. maria: For screen readers we should expose full path via aria-label on the frame row, not just visual tooltip. something like: aria-label="file path: /very/long/path/..." with full text included. jamie: yeah — proposal: keep the visual truncation, but make row a focusable button and add aria-describedby referencing a hidden element with full text. That keeps density but improves a11y. sasha: Also noticed the correlation ID badge copy: it says "corr id" in smallcaps in the timeline. Can we change to "Correlation ID" and make it copyable? People copy/paste that constantly. oliver: Agreed. Also add a small "copy" affordance on hover rather than making the whole badge clickable. maria: tiny nit on export: the export action currently says "Export" in the toolbar. In context it’s ambiguous — are we exporting a single trace, hits, CSV, or JSON? Suggest changing it to a split button: "Export trace ▼" with format options: JSON, HAR, CSV. jamie: Split button seems right. Default to JSON. Also, export filename should include trace id and timestamp so it's searchable: redwood-trace--20250314.json (example). sasha: UX question: when someone exports CSV we flatten nested spans. That flattening can be lossy. Could we add a one-line warning: "CSV flattens nested spans. Use JSON for fidelity." under the format selector. oliver: Accessibility for the split button: ensure the dropdown is keyboard operable with arrow keys and that menu items have role=menuitemradio or menuitem — tests failing currently on NVDA. maria: copy tweak: the frame action currently says "Open in source" — developers were confused if it meant repo or local mapping. Maybe "Open in code (repo)" or add a small repo icon. jamie: Also brought up in support — users want to search within a trace for text in stack frames (function names). Could be a mini-search bar scoped to the trace drilldown. Quick implementation: add a ctrl/cmd+f hotkey that focuses a trace-search input, separate from browser find. sasha: Love the hotkey idea. Must document it on the help tooltip though and allow users to disable it (some use browser find exclusively). oliver: Another a11y edge: when expanding a collapsed group of frames, focus should move to the first newly revealed frame and announce "n frames expanded" via live region. Right now focus stays on the toggle which is confusing. maria: Small visual polish: stack frames with user code vs library code should have slightly different backgrounds or a chip that says "user"/"lib" to make scanning easier. Also ensure color contrast meets AA. jamie: Quick implementation notes (for eng): ```
...
/very/long/path/to/file.js:120 ``` sasha: Perfect. Can we add an automated visual test for long path wrapping and SR text presence? maria: I'll add these items to the design PR and pair with oliver for the a11y test cases. Putting together suggested copy strings and aria patterns now. oliver: If you post the PR link I’ll review keyboard interactions and NVDA behavior. jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/482 — includes screenshots and the split-export mock. sasha: Leaving a few inline comments on the PR re: wording. Also raised an issue about analytics event for export format (we should track JSON vs CSV exports). maria: noted. I'll add telemetry to the export flow. ux-bot: Reminder: design review sync tomorrow 11:00 — will queue this for 11:15 slot. :spiral_calendar: jamie: thanks — see you all then.
